profile.headline: Technical Program Manager at Google
profile.summary:
Project/Program Manager, Technical Lead, and Software Developer in a fast-paced, high-mix business.  Experienced at all project phases from cradle to grave (proposal/estimation, gathering requirements, research, architecting solutions, implementation, test, operation, maintenance, and support) in a customer-driven organization.

Currently leading and improving several business processes across a Google Product Area (maintaining roadmaps, setting goals, prioritization, risk reduction, technical debt reduction).

Recent experience includes managing a large software project across multiple Google Product Areas, developing automation to ease management of compute resources, and participating in team management. Prior to that: developing real-time embedded C/C++ applications under CentOS and uClinux, managing interdisciplinary project teams of 1-8 engineers, designing cryptographic security solutions, and developing TETRA Layer 2/3 protocol parsing in a C# GUI application.

Specialties: Embedded C/C++ application development, Layer 2/3 protocol stacks of various wireless technologies (see skills), technical and project leadership of small teams, direct customer interaction

positions.title: Technical Program Manager, Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Own and coordinate process for quarterly goal setting, prioritization, monitoring, and scoring across two product areas (~10 teams)
- Risk management & strategy for risk burndown across product area
- Lead quarterly/semi-annual goal setting, prioritization, monitoring, and scoring process for my teams; iteratively streamlined the process over many years and integrated with various reporting systems [10 years]
- Program Management for an ambitious project to define, measure, and drive compliance with production standards across thousands of individual services to reduce cognitive load, enable SRE to support more services with fewer staff, and reduce the risk of outages by making the best automation tools available to more developers [2 years]
- Program Management for a Google-wide product that automatically analyzes new releases as they are rolling out to production, detects regressions, and blocks bad releases [1.5 years]
- Program Management for a high-visibility, cross-team product that provides service monitoring dashboards to SRE and development teams in every Google product area [3 years]
- Administer and provide oncall support for shared resource pools used by all Ads engineers; led migration effort to move thousands of users from legacy resources into a more efficient and resilient structure; developed tools to eliminate every user's toil of acquiring resources when forced to move to a new location (automatic registration) [2.5 years]
- Mentor and provide a sounding board for team members, team leaders, and other TPMs; host social chats for an employee resource group; moderate a large mailing list
- Plan and manage resources for a collection of services associated with my team [2 years]
- Act as a force multiplier for management, identifying and correcting deficiencies in processes and morale
- Manage team work backlog as owner and champion of Kanban and Scrum processes, design reviews, working groups, and prioritization efforts
positions.insights: Project Coordination, Business Process Improvement and +3 skills

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in requirements, design, prototyping, implementation, and test phases of development life cycle. Developed embedded software, primarily in embedded C/C++, and shell scripts.  Projects include:
- UDP Image Transfer via proprietary protocol
- Metadata Formatting and Forwarding in real-time via RS-422, UNIX domain sockets, and TCP connections
- Profile, diagnose, and resolve networking issues to achieve maximum throughput and minimum latency on a gigE network for live video streaming.
- Rewrote application upgrade script to roll back failed upgrades better and to allow easy customization of the upgrade package.
- Streamlined build, package, and deploy process to reduce need for time-consuming flash process that required removing the cover to access a debug connector.

positions.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project leadership & management
Technical leadership
Embedded software development
Application software development

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, implemented, and tested embedded and GUI software in C, C++, and Visual C# to provide TETRA network survey capabilities and stream GSM phone calls to host.  Reverse engineered commercial radio for proof-of-concept.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead of the Virtual Cell Site (VCS) development project, which reduced cost by 20x and enabled load testing earlier in the life cycle to catch defects sooner
